bece1db8667667241b94509d0e38594bb696f035.summary: QNAP security advisory QSA-20-02, published June 2020, on the eCh0raix ransomware (MR1904). The advisory says the ransomware has been reported to target QNAP NAS devices by exploiting vulnerabilities in earlier QTS and Photo Station versions. QNAP says these issues were fixed in releases from September 2019 and recommends updating QTS and Photo Station to the latest versions.

dates.q: We have already fixed these issues in recent releases since September 2019.
dates.what: Fixes for these issues began to be released
